assets.prompt: Create one production sprite atlas for a children’s Don Gato felt story. Exactly SIX completely separated cutout assets in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid, each centered inside its cell with generous fully transparent gutters. No contact sheet labels, no panel borders, no background or floor, actual transparent alpha. Style: exquisite miniature needle-felt animals and props with dense visible wool fibers, soft warm light from upper left, rounded handmade forms, matches cream-stucco and teal-shutter Spanish village diorama. Top row left: one tiny cute gray mouse standing upright facing right in three-quarter profile, large pink inner ears, black bead eyes, little pink nose, curled thin wool tail, no clothing, right paw raised in a shy wave. Top row center: the SAME gray mouse standing facing right, tender expression, holding one comically oversized pink daisy on a long green stem, flower taller than mouse, paws wrapped around stem, full tail visible. Top row right: a single open folding hand fan, dusty rose felt with scalloped ivory lace edges and cream ribs, handle pointing down, front view. Bottom row left: one small ivory felt handkerchief with delicate lace edge, draped triangle with soft folds, entirely separate object. Bottom row center: a single cute silver-blue felt sardine with stitched scales, black bead eye, horizontal with head to the left and tail right, no plate. Bottom row right: a single doctor's small brown felt clipboard with pale cream paper, viewed directly from front, brass clip at TOP, paper bearing a simple stitched drawing of a cat face and three short teal scribble lines underneath, no readable text, no words. All six assets full extent visible, not touching each other, generous padding, 3x2 equally sized cells. Each sprite should fill about 72 percent of its cell. No cast shadows outside assets.

Create a NEW transparent character sprite atlas, exactly SIX separate full-body character poses in a precise 3-column by 2-row grid. Reference 1 establishes Don Gato identity: adorable orange tabby needle-felt cat, cream muzzle, teal waistcoat with brass buttons, red bow tie. Reference 2 establishes the lady cat: plump fluffy white felt cat, green eyes, dusty rose neck bow. Preserve those exact identities, face proportions, handcrafted wool fibers, soft light, and clothing. All sprites isolated on true transparent alpha, no environment, no floor, no shadows outside sprites, no grid lines, no text. Each character fully within its cell, transparent 30-pixel gutters, no adjacent overlap. TOP ROW: LEFT: Don Gato lying horizontally exactly like the resting bandaged pose in reference 1 (head on LEFT, rear and bandaged leg on RIGHT), both eyes closed, a little wrinkled lifted nose as if smelling something delicious, one ear subtly perked, body still resting, no object under him. CENTER: exactly the SAME horizontally resting Don Gato, same dimensions and head-left orientation and bandage and clothing as top-left, but ONE eye is half OPEN with a curious sideways glance, other eye closed, ear perked, body still lying down. These two lying poses should have matching outline and position for animation. RIGHT: Don Gato STANDING, making an exaggerated polite theatrical bow, head and torso leaning forward/down, both paws tucked behind his back, facing three-quarter toward the viewer, full feet and tail visible, joyful modest smile, no fish or props. BOTTOM ROW: LEFT: the white lady cat sitting upright, friendly bashful smile, one paw raised in a little wave, other paw resting by chest, no props. CENTER: the same seated white lady cat holding a dusty rose and ivory lace folding fan up high in front of her face so the fan hides her eyes and nose; only her two white ears visible above it. RIGHT: exactly the same seated white lady cat and fan, now the fan is held LOWER at her mouth so both large curious green eyes peek clearly OVER the top of it. Lady poses must have same scale and seated silhouette. One character per cell, all limbs included, consistent needle felt material, warm tender comedic storybook look.

Create a NEW transparent sprite sheet with exactly THREE separate full-body cat poses, in THREE equal columns and ONE row. Use the reference as the character identity and material guide. Match the same fine needle-felt wool fibers, detailed handmade doll craftsmanship, warm light, round expressive faces, tiny spectacles and wardrobe. Entire background truly transparent alpha, no floor, no extra shadows, no backdrop, no text, no column lines. Leave wide transparent gutters between the three characters and padding at all edges; no overlaps. Left column: the reference BROWN tabby DOCTOR cat with small round brass spectacles, white doctor's coat and teal stethoscope. Doctor leaning slightly FORWARD toward the RIGHT, one paw holding the stethoscope chestpiece out to the RIGHT at low waist height so it can be placed on a reclining patient, tubing visibly connects to earpieces in the doctor's ears. Other paw supports a small brown leather doctor's bag near his left leg. Concerned thoughtful but cute expression. Middle column: the reference GRAY tabby DOCTOR cat, brass round spectacles, white coat, both paws held in front of body at belly height with a visible gap as if holding the sides of a clipboard that will be added separately. Empty paws, NO clipboard, no bag. Looking down thoughtfully at the empty space between his paws, full legs and feet visible. Right column: the reference PLUMP WHITE LADY CAT, big green eyes, dusty rose neck ribbon, seated. Both paws raised beside her cheeks in delighted surprise, mouth a small O, no fan and NO handkerchief. Full tail and feet visible. All three coherent scale, all full-body. Characters fill 75 percent of their individual cells.
